title: Hexus Salts Fizzy Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Fizzy Cherry by Hexus captures the familiar taste of sweet Cherry with a sparkling soda-style lift. The Cherry brings a rich, syrupy fruit flavour, while the fizzy element adds a bright, refreshing finish. It's a nostalgic, well-rounded blend that balances sweetness with a gentle tang ideal for vapers who enjoy confectionery or drink-inspired profiles. This nicotine salt e-liquid delivers smooth, rapid nicotine satisfaction with a comfortable throat hit. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it performs best in pod kits , refillable vapes and other MTL devices. Hexus Nic Salts come in 10mg and 20mg strengths with flavours spanning fruits, fizz, and menthols for a flavour-packed vape.
